description: Removal of ~150 dead code items (~1,500+ lines) identified during comprehensive firmware audit. Organized by module for safe, incremental cleanup.

userStories.title: Remove dead code from main.ino
userStories.description: Remove unused global variables and empty function stubs: cloud_magnet_validation[1024] buffer, handleCartridgeInserted()/handleCartridgeRemoved() empty stubs.
acceptanceCriteria: cloud_magnet_validation[1024] removed if not referenced by Particle.variable
userStories.notes: cloud_magnet_validation IS used by Particle.variable() on line 235 - check if this cloud variable is actually needed before removing.

userStories.title: Remove unused constants from HardwareConfig.h
userStories.description: Remove ~35 unused constants: LEGACY_HARDWARE_VERSION, LASER_PWM_*, LED_*, MOTOR_MOVE_DURATION_UNIT, STAGE_* positions, BARCODE_TYPE_* constants superseded by enum, ADC_*, I2C_*, THERMISTOR_SCALE, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: Each constant verified unused via grep before removal
All remaining constants are actively referenced
userStories.notes: Must verify each constant is truly unused. Some may be referenced in SerialCommands.cpp.

userStories.title: Remove dead functions from MotorController
userStories.description: Remove 15 dead functions: moveToPositionAsync(), stepRelative(), async oscillation system (start/stop/update/isOscillating), position helpers (moveToHome/TestStart/OpticalRead/Magnetometer/ShippingBolt), reset(), micronsToSteps(), stepsToMicrons(), calculateStepDelayForIntegration().
acceptanceCriteria: Each function verified uncalled via grep before removal
userStories.notes: Some functions may be called from SerialCommands.cpp - verify all call sites.

userStories.title: Remove dead functions from BuzzerController
userStories.description: Remove 13 dead functions: 5 predefined alert wrappers, tone queue system, volume control (no-op). Volume _volumeLevel is set but never applied to hardware.
acceptanceCriteria: Each function verified uncalled via grep before removal
Tone queue and volume infrastructure removed
playTone(), playErrorMelody(), playSuccessMelody(), startPeriodicAlert(), stopPeriodicAlert(), update(), init() preserved
userStories.notes: Verify which functions are called from main.ino and SerialCommands.cpp before removal.

userStories.title: Remove dead functions from AS7341 driver
userStories.description: Remove 18 dead functions: interrupt configuration, flicker detection, GPIO control. These features are not used by the spectrophotometer module.
acceptanceCriteria: Each function verified uncalled via grep before removal
Core measurement functions preserved: begin(), startMeasure(), readAllChannels(), setGain(), setIntegrationTime()
userStories.notes: Be careful not to remove functions that are called internally by the measurement pipeline.

userStories.title: Remove dead functions from Spectrophotometer
userStories.description: Remove readingContinuous() (184 lines), continuous mode API (startContinuousMode, stopContinuousMode, processContinuousMode), setTestStartTime() (never called). ~250 lines removable.
acceptanceCriteria: readingContinuous() and continuous mode API removed
readChannel() and readAllChannels() preserved and functional
userStories.notes: Verify no serial commands reference continuous mode before removing.

userStories.title: Remove dead functions from LEDController
userStories.description: Entire state/prompt/priority system (~350 lines) is bypassed - main.ino only uses init(), setPattern(), update(). Remove unused state management, prompt system, and priority queue.
userStories.notes: Verify no serial commands use the state/prompt/priority API.

userStories.title: Remove dead code from HAL, TestRunner, StateMachine, SerialCommands
userStories.description: HAL: 6 unused functions (buzzForDuration, getHeaterOnDuration, readSpectroChannel, i2cDevicePresent, delayUs, getSpectroPin). TestRunner: bcodeDelayLoop() declared but never defined, _get_temp_callback/_get_stage_position_callback never invoked. StateMachine: onCartridgeInserted/Removed never called, isHeatingRequired trivial wrapper. SerialCommands: printCategoryHelp, getCategory, getCategoryName, CommandCategory enum, getSerialCommands, handleSetPulseParams/handleOutputReadings no-ops.
acceptanceCriteria: Each function verified uncalled before removal
All removals from both .h and .cpp files
userStories.notes: Large story - may need to be split if too many files touched at once.

userStories.title: Remove dead code from SupabaseClient and StorageManager
userStories.description: SupabaseClient: conflicting callback typedefs with CloudProtocol.h, 4 fake async methods, unused SUPABASE_ROOT_CA (32 lines), HTTP timeout constants, CACHE_DIR. StorageManager: _assayBuffer[6000] should be local, unused BUFFER_DIR constant.
acceptanceCriteria: _assayBuffer moved to local scope or removed if unused
userStories.notes: Be careful with callback typedefs - may need to consolidate rather than just delete.
